design: Title-free scientific schematic with three aligned fields, process topology, terrain and residual mechanisms, and a paired 2 × 2 MAE interaction plot; no footer.

scientific_scope.design: Ten structures × two temperature inputs × two residual options; corrections retain all ten structures.
scientific_scope.selection: CB-FL-S is the selected RAW process structure: sequential beta chilling and linear forcing. Selection is not a filter on the correction experiment.
scientific_scope.terrain: Fixed lapse-rate correction precedes separate process recalibration; surface and vines are conceptual, not an observed terrain dataset.
scientific_scope.residual: Stage-specific residual design uses process states and environment; the Δd box is not a claim about neural-network architecture.
scientific_scope.target: Observed minus raw out-of-fold process date, learned with grouped nested refits.
scientific_scope.output: Correction adjusts attained dates; it does not repair non-attainment or modify process thermal states.
scientific_scope.validation: Grouped site holdouts within five represented environmental zones; not independent regional transfer.
scientific_scope.gains: The 2 × 2 paired plot shows the convergence of terrain-input MAEs after residual learning. No additive mechanism is assumed.

quantitative_results.weighting: Equal models, sites within each stage, and four stages
quantitative_results.plot: Connected point estimates, with endpoint leader labels and circle/diamond coding; no uncertainty intervals are implied.

verification.method: Matplotlib rendered text extents asserted within canvas and above footer exclusion zone.
